price.quote: First off, let’s take a look at the specs on the newly released Velotric Fold Lite. It features the same frame and outward design as the existing Velotric Fold, but slashes the price of US $1,399 MSRP down to just $1,099.
price.basis: launch price $1,099 (the $1,399 is the regular Fold 1)

cls.basis: multi-class; out of box is "Default Speed ⟶ 20 MPH" with a throttle ("Throttle Range ⟶ 40 Miles"), i.e. Class 2

spd.basis: default; adjustable to 28 mph ("Max Speed Adjustable Range ⟶ 12~28 MPH")

wh.quote: To get to that attractive price tag, the two biggest changes appear to be trimming the motor power from 750W to 500W, and reducing the UL-listed battery from 608 Wh of capacity down to 486 Wh, which amounts to around 20% less battery.

wt.basis: maker doesn't say whether battery is included

wt.quote: The 61 lb (28 kg) folding e-bike includes a coil spring front suspension fork, hydraulic disc brakes, 20×3.0″ tires, and a Shimano 7-speed shifter.

The 61 lb (28 kg) folding e-bike includes a coil spring front suspension fork, hydraulic disc brakes, 20×3.0″ tires, and a Shimano 7-speed shifter.

notes: Maker page shows $1,099.00 (no crossed-out price) and 'Sold out' (not stated as discontinued).
